
		<h2>
			<a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/xiangji/p/19125327" title="发布于 2025-10-04 09:38">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">PocoEmit遥遥领先于AutoMapper之打通充血模型的任督二脉</span>
    

</a>

		</h2>
		<div class="postText"><div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h2 id="一充血模型和失血模型">一、充血模型和失血模型</h2>
<h3 id="1-充血模型的优势">1. 充血模型的优势</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>充血模型更加OOP</li>
<li>充血模型代码可读性更好</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="11-充血模型伪代码">1.1 充血模型伪代码</h4>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var messageDto = controller.ReadDto();
var message = messageDto.ToEntity();
message.Save();
</code></pre>
<h4 id="12-失血模型伪代码">1.2 失血模型伪代码</h4>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var messageDto = controller.ReadDto();
var message = messageDto.ToEntity();
var messageService = controller.GetMessageService();
messageService.Save(message);
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-充血模型爱你不容易">2. 充血模型爱你不容易</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>大部分程序员都知道充血模型好,想实现却很难</li>
<li>大部分业务逻辑都需要依赖外部服务</li>
<li>充血模型需要用到外部服务,又不想依赖外部服务的具体实现</li>
<li>很容易想到使用IOC的依赖注入来解决</li>
<li>我们给DTO注入服务还行,因为IOC参与了controller过程</li>
<li>当DTO发生转化时,新增的服务IOC还是有点力不从心</li>
<li>没法引用外部服务的充血模型气血不通,业务表达能力大大下降</li>
<li>这也是大部分人弃用充血模型的主要原因,不好用还不如不用</li>
<li>这个任督二脉PocoEmit可以帮你打通</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="二首先来个case演示一下">二、首先来个Case演示一下</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>Dto转化为实体</li>
<li>但是实体有更多逻辑依赖外部服务,这些外部服务Dto不见得提供的了</li>
<li>这就需要注入</li>
<li>PocoEmit支持构造函数参数注入和属性注入</li>
<li>IMapper对象是默认支持注入的服务</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="1-entity比dto多出来的mapper可以注入">1. Entity比Dto多出来的Mapper可以注入</h3>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">class MessageDto
{
    public string Message { get; set; }
}
class MessageEntity
{
    public IMapper Mapper { get; set; }
    public string Message { get; set; }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-转化并注入的代码">2. 转化并注入的代码</h3>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var mapper = Mapper.Create();
var dto = new MessageDto { Message = "Hello UseMapper" };
MessageEntity message = mapper.Convert&lt;MessageDto, MessageEntity&gt;(dto);
Assert.NotNull(message.Mapper);
</code></pre>
<h2 id="三再演示注入自定义的服务">三、再演示注入自定义的服务</h2>
<h3 id="1-userdomain比dto多出来的repository可以注入">1. UserDomain比Dto多出来的Repository可以注入</h3>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">class UserDTO
{
    public int Id { get; set; }
    public string Name { get; set; }
}
class UserDomain(UserRepository repository, int id, string name)
{
    private readonly UserRepository _repository = repository;
    public UserRepository Repository
        =&gt; _repository;
    public int Id { get; } = id;
    public string Name { get; } = name;
    // ...
}
class UserRepository
{
    void Add(UserDomain user) { }
    void Update(UserDomain entity) { }
    void Remove(UserDomain entity) { }
    public static readonly UserRepository Instance = new();
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-注册转化并注入的代码">2. 注册、转化并注入的代码</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>通过UseDefault可以注入服务</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">IMapper mapper = Mapper.Create()
    .UseDefault(UserRepository.Instance);
var dto = new UserDTO { Id = 1, Name = "Jxj" };
UserDomain user = mapper.Convert&lt;UserDTO, UserDomain&gt;(dto);
Assert.NotNull(user.Repository);
</code></pre>
<h2 id="四注入ioc容器的case">四、注入IOC容器的Case</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>注入IOC容器需要安装nuget包PocoEmit.ServiceProvider</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="1-包含ioc容器的实体">1. 包含IOC容器的实体</h3>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">class UserWithServiceProvider
{
    public int Id { get; set; }
    public string Name { get; set; }
    public IServiceProvider ServiceProvider { get; set; }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-注册转化并注入的代码-1">2. 注册、转化并注入的代码</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>UseSingleton是把容器作为唯一容器注入</li>
<li>UseScope是使用当前Scope子容器</li>
<li>UseContext是在Mvc下,使用当前HttpContext的RequestServices子容器</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var services = new ServiceCollection();
var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
var mapper = Mapper.Create();
mapper.UseSingleton(serviceProvider);
var dto = new UserDTO { Id = 1, Name = "Jxj" };
UserWithServiceProvider user = mapper.Convert&lt;UserDTO, UserWithServiceProvider&gt;(dto);
Assert.NotNull(user.ServiceProvider);
</code></pre>
<h2 id="五当然还可以注入容器内的服务">五、当然还可以注入容器内的服务</h2>
<h3 id="1-userdomain多出来的repository需要注入">1. UserDomain多出来的Repository需要注入</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>这次我们用IOC来管理Repository</li>
<li>这样才能更好的利用依赖注入</li>
<li>Repository可能还会依赖其他的服务</li>
<li>手动维护服务对象可能会很麻烦,IOC容器擅长维护这些复杂关系</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">    class UserDomain(UserRepository repository, int id, string name)
    {
        private readonly UserRepository _repository = repository;
        public UserRepository Repository
            =&gt; _repository;
        public int Id { get; } = id;
        public string Name { get; } = name;
        // ...
    }
    class UserRepository
    {
        void Add(UserDomain user) { }
        void Update(UserDomain entity) { }
        void Remove(UserDomain entity) { }
    }
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-注册转化并注入的代码-2">2. 注册、转化并注入的代码</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>通过UseScope注入IOC容器</li>
<li>通过UseDefault告知这个类型从IOC容器中注入</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var services = new ServiceCollection()
    .AddScoped&lt;UserRepository&gt;();
var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
var mapper = Mapper.Create();
mapper.UseScope(serviceProvider)
     .UseDefault&lt;UserRepository&gt;();
var dto = new UserDTO { Id = 1, Name = "Jxj" };
UserDomain user = mapper.Convert&lt;UserDTO, UserDomain&gt;(dto);
Assert.NotNull(user.Repository);
</code></pre>
<h2 id="六支持ioc容器的特性">六、支持IOC容器的特性</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>支持FromKeyedServices</li>
<li>支持FromServices</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="1-fromkeyedservices标记注入点和服务键">1. FromKeyedServices标记注入点和服务键</h3>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">class UserDomain1([FromKeyedServices("User1")]UserRepository repository, int id, string name)
    : UserDomain(repository, id, name)
{
}
class UserDomain2([FromKeyedServices("User2")] UserRepository repository, int id, string name)
    : UserDomain(repository, id, name)
{
}
class UserDomain(UserRepository repository, int id, string name)
{
    private readonly UserRepository _repository = repository;
    public UserRepository Repository
        =&gt; _repository;
    public int Id { get; } = id;
    public string Name { get; } = name;
    // ...
}
class UserRepository(string tableName)
{
    private readonly string _tableName = tableName;
    public string TableName 
        =&gt; _tableName;
    void Add(UserDomain user) { }
    void Update(UserDomain entity) { }
    void Remove(UserDomain entity) { }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-注册转化并注入的代码-3">2. 注册、转化并注入的代码</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>由于识别出FromKeyedServices,就不需要UseDefault</li>
<li>这样简洁又优雅</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">string table1 = "User1";
string table2 = "User2";
var services = new ServiceCollection()
    .AddKeyedScoped(table1, (_, _) =&gt; new UserRepository(table1))
    .AddKeyedScoped(table2, (_, _) =&gt; new UserRepository(table2));
var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
var mapper = Mapper.Create();
mapper.UseScope(serviceProvider);
var dto = new UserDTO { Id = 1, Name = "Jxj" };
UserDomain user = mapper.Convert&lt;UserDTO, UserDomain1&gt;(dto);
Assert.NotNull(user.Repository);
UserDomain user2 = mapper.Convert&lt;UserDTO, UserDomain2&gt;(dto);
Assert.NotNull(user2.Repository);
</code></pre>
<h2 id="七竞品类似的功能">七、竞品类似的功能</h2>
<h3 id="1-automapper不支持">1. AutoMapper不支持</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>AutoMapper的NullSubstitute用来指定源属性为null时的默认值</li>
<li>用AutoMapper实现类似功能需要复杂的自定义IValueResolver来实现</li>
<li>PocoEmit在源无法匹配或源字段为null都可能触发依赖注入</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="2-ef有类似功能">2. EF有类似功能</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>不过貌似只支持EF内部某些服务</li>
<li>请参阅 <a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/tcjiaan/p/19077173" target="_blank">EF Core实体类的依赖注入</a></li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="八总结">八、总结</h2>
<h3 id="1-oom映射需要依赖注入">1. OOM映射需要依赖注入</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>DTO、实体、领域模型如果有业务逻辑就需要依赖外部服务</li>
<li>支持按类型注入,也支持按指定的参数或属性注入</li>
<li>支持FromKeyedServices和FromServices</li>
<li>需要外部服务就需要依赖注入</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="2-pocoemit的依赖注入助力程序分层架构">2. PocoEmit的依赖注入助力程序分层架构</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>依赖注入的加持每一层想调用啥就调用啥</li>
<li>同时也让每一层更好的划分让调用啥,不让调用啥更容易控制</li>
<li>同时也让业务需要划分多少层就划分多层变得简单</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="3-ioc容器使用需要注意">3. IOC容器使用需要注意</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>简单作业单容器,使用UseSingleton即可</li>
<li>多线程需要使用UseScope</li>
<li>Mvc(含WebApi)逻辑处理使用UseContext</li>
<li>UseContext需要引用nuget包PocoEmit.Mvc</li>
<li>如果是Mvc异步处理或Quartz类似作业不要用UseContext</li>
<li>就怕异步中获取到了HttpContext,但执行中途被释放了,后面就可能异常了</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
